notes.title: Monster City: A Monster College Story new update version 0.5.0!

Hey everyone!

Here’s a brand-new version of Monster City, packed with fresh content, visual upgrades, and a bunch of important bug fixes. Dive in and enjoy!

✨ v0.5.0 Changelog:

🔥 5 new Story scenes (playable in both Story and Sandbox modes)

🔥 New shapeshifting mini-encounters with Lenny during Deliveries

🔥 New chatting scene with Ulva at Enchan’tea

📖 10K+ words

📸 350+ new images

🎞️ 7 new animations

🐛 Bug Fixes:

-Fixed the AI Toggle in Settings (it should now work properly)

-Visiting Felvia’s place no longer costs double MPs (back to 1MP)

-Fixed missing audio notifications for Relationship updates

-Visiting Ulva’s shop for the first time no longer repeats itself; now it will trigger a new scene after being played through

-The Delivery scene with the guy from the first scene at the restaurant now plays only once — making room for Lenny’s shapeshifting antics in future visits

notes.title: Monster City: A Monster College Story new update version 0.4.0!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Here’s a brand-new version packed with fresh content and quality-of-life features. Please make sure to check out the details below — there are some important adjustments you won’t want to miss.

✨ v0.4.0 Changelog:

🔥 5 new Story scenes

🔥 New mini-loops for the MMC Club with Hilde

🔥 New Felvia scenes at the Office (Sandbox mode only!)

🔥 Adam’s social page added to MonstaCram

🔥 New feature available in the Library

📖 ~7K new words (+8K in the Beastiary!)

📸 380 images

🎞️ 15 animations


🐞 Bug Fixes:

-Fixed missing music in some scenes

-Fixed scenes not properly removing the stats frame/screen

-Other minor bug fixes


🔧 Adjustments & Improvements:

-MonstaCram can now be accessed from all maps, not just the Room Hub, for quicker To-Do list checks.

-Added MC’s social page, a few posts, and Kass’s Relationship Points tracker.

-Added a settings toggle to turn AI-generated animations on/off. (I don’t love using AI-generated stuff, but many creators do — so I want to keep up and still give you the choice.)

-Added a toggle for showing/hiding pronouns on MonstaCram's character pages. (When I added them, I was inspired by real social media trends — but I understand not everyone wants them. Now you can switch them off if you prefer!)

-New Research feature in the Library: After completing the storyline that involves Bea, Dragomira, and Tanja (from v0.3.0), you’ll unlock a Beastiary-like function in the Library. You can do research and read about the creatures and lore of the Monster College universe. It’s still a work-in-progress — some entries are missing or will be adjusted — but I know many of you will appreciate the extra worldbuilding.


Enjoy the update, and thank you all so much for your support — you’re helping Monster City grow with every release!

Your feedback, bug reports, and suggestions keep me going, so keep them coming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545512/56ef1de082fd5e0b2654b3e5d45afc8b279a3284.png[/img]
